results.title: Edenorte completes installation of 37 MVA transformer at the Samaná Substation
results.description: Samaná.-After a workday coordinated and executed by technicians from the Northern Electricity Distribution Company (Edenorte), the installation of a new 37 MVA power transformer at the Samaná Substation was successfully completed.
